Indulge in the serenity of nature's beauty and create lasting memories at our picturesque retreat. | Nestled in the serene hills of Ulupuni, The Mountain Table offers a peaceful escape from the hustle and bustle of city life. Our homestay is a place where you can unwind, relax, and immerse yourself in the beauty of nature. Come and experience the tranquil charm of The Mountain Table. | OUR ROOMS | Indulge in the comfort of our well-appointed rooms, each offering breathtaking views of the mist-covered hills. The cozy ambiance and modern amenities ensure a delightful stay amidst the natural splendor. | Step into our three cozy rooms, where rustic charm meets modern comfort. Wake up to the sound of birds chirping and the gentle rustle of leaves outside your window, and feel the stresses of everyday life melt away in the embrace of nature. | Explore | OUR SERVICES | 01 | Complimentary breakfast | Delight in a delectable spread of local cuisine with our complimentary breakfast offerings, our chef showcases the region's flavours. | 02 | Garden & tea plantation | Stroll through our lush garden and tea Plantation and revel in the tranquillity of the surroundings. | 03 | Infinity pool | Take a refreshing dip in our infinity pool while soaking in the panoramic vistas of the misty hills and meadows | Complimentary Wi-Fi | Stay connected with our complimentary Wi-Fi access and share your memorable moments with loved ones. | Daily housekeeping | Let us take care of the daily housekeeping, ensuring that your space remains pristine throughout your stay. | Modern amenities | Experience the epitome of leisure and entertainment with our resort's modern amenities | DISCOVER | GUEST REVIEW | “A tranquil haven amidst nature's embrace. The Mountain Table provided an enchanting retreat that exceeded all expectations.” | Immerse yourself in the beauty of nature at The Mountain Table. An experience that lingers in the heart and beckons you to return. | The Mountain Table is a testament to serenity and hospitality. A destination that promises rejuvenation and lasting memories.
